_comment: Machine-readable lifecycle transition registry. Mirrors the markdown specs (order.md, user-account.md, support-ticket.md, document.md). Source of truth for the interactive explorer in /explorer. classification is derived from canonical ordinal positions for canonical statuses; branch statuses have a null ordinal and are classified as 'lateral'.

order.label: Order
order.description: Fulfillment pipeline from cart to delivery.

descriptions.Draft: Order being assembled; not yet submitted.
descriptions.Submitted: Customer has confirmed intent; awaiting merchant acknowledgement.
descriptions.Confirmed: Merchant has accepted the order; payment authorized.
descriptions.Processing: Items are being picked, packed, or prepared.
descriptions.Shipped: Order dispatched; in transit with a carrier.
descriptions.Delivered: Carrier confirms delivery to the recipient.
descriptions.Completed: Post-delivery window closed; order fully settled.
descriptions.Cancelled: Order voided. Reachable from most pre-shipment states.
descriptions.Return Requested: Customer has initiated a return after delivery.
descriptions.Returned: Goods received back; refund or credit issued.

transitions.cause: Customer or merchant cancels before fulfillment
Fulfillment started in error; order pulled back for re-confirmation (e.g., payment issue discovered post-processing)
transitions.handling: Any inventory reservation or payment capture triggered at Confirmed -> Processing may need to be reversed or re-evaluated.

transitions.cause: Payment authorization expired; order needs re-authorization
transitions.handling: Payment authorization state is now uncertain; downstream invoice or billing records should not be finalized until Confirmed is re-observed.

transitions.cause: Carrier returned package before delivery; order re-enters fulfillment
transitions.handling: A shipping label or dispatch notification may have already been sent to the customer. The regression indicates the upstream system has invalidated that dispatch.

transitions.cause: Delivery scan was erroneous; carrier corrects status
transitions.handling: A delivery confirmation sent to the customer may be premature. This is rare and usually a data correction in the carrier integration.

user-account.label: User Account
user-account.description: Identity and access from registration to deactivation.

descriptions.Pending Verification: Account created; email/identity not yet confirmed.
descriptions.Locked: Temporarily inaccessible due to security policy (e.g., too many failed logins).
descriptions.Suspended: Administratively restricted; the user cannot log in.
descriptions.Pending Deletion: User requested account deletion; grace period is running.

transitions.cause: Verification TTL expired with no action
User completes unlock flow or admin resets
Admin lifts suspension; account restored to normal use
transitions.handling: The most common regression. Access controls, tokens, and session state need to be re-evaluated as if the account is healthy again.

transitions.cause: Upstream system reverses a permanent close (exceptional; usually a data correction)
transitions.handling: Rare and significant. If any data anonymisation or deletion was triggered upon Deactivated, this regression signals a serious upstream correction. Flag immediately.

transitions.cause: Re-verification required (e.g., security policy change, email address changed)
transitions.handling: The account is functionally restricted until reverified. Any sessions or tokens issued during Active should be treated as potentially stale.

support-ticket.label: Support Ticket
support-ticket.description: Issue resolution from open to closed.

descriptions.Open: Ticket received; not yet assigned or worked.
descriptions.In Progress: An agent is actively investigating or working the issue.
descriptions.Pending Customer: Waiting on information or confirmation from the customer.
descriptions.Pending Third Party: Blocked on an external party (vendor, partner, internal team).
descriptions.Resolved: Agent has marked the issue as fixed.
descriptions.Closed: Confirmed resolved or auto-closed after inactivity.
descriptions.Reopened: Customer reports the issue persists after resolution or close.

transitions.cause: Customer confirms or auto-close TTL elapses
Agent escalates or SLA timer triggers
Agent unassigns ticket; returns to unworked queue
transitions.handling: The ticket effectively re-queues. Any SLA clock adjustments made when the ticket was assigned may need recalculating.

transitions.cause: Resolution found to be incomplete or incorrect
transitions.handling: The most operationally significant regression. Any customer-facing 'your issue is resolved' communication triggered at Resolved is now incorrect. Flag for potential follow-up messaging.

transitions.cause: Auto-close was premature; ticket re-opened for review
transitions.handling: If Closed triggered satisfaction survey dispatch or case archival, note those as premature. Do not re-trigger them when Closed is re-observed.

transitions.cause: Escalation reversed; ticket returned to general queue (regresses past In Progress)
transitions.handling: The ticket has skipped backward past In Progress. Treat as a gap of two ordinal positions and consider whether any intermediate handlers for In Progress need to run.

document.label: Document / Content
document.description: Editorial workflow from draft to archive.

descriptions.Draft: Being written; only visible to the author and collaborators.
descriptions.In Review: Submitted for editorial or peer review.
descriptions.Changes Requested: Reviewer has returned the document for revisions.
descriptions.Approved: Cleared by reviewer(s); ready for publishing.
descriptions.Scheduled: Approved and queued for automatic publication at a future datetime.
descriptions.Published: Publicly visible or accessible to the target audience.
descriptions.Unpublished: Temporarily pulled from public view; not yet archived.
descriptions.Archived: Retired; no longer actively maintained or publicly visible.

transitions.cause: Author sets a future publish date
Author or admin pulls content from public view
Reviewer withdraws from review; document returned to author for rework
transitions.handling: Common in editorial workflows. The review cycle resets. Any notifications sent to reviewers about the submission should be noted as superseded.

transitions.cause: Approval revoked (e.g., new stakeholder objects, policy changed)
transitions.handling: Approval was granted but then revoked. Any scheduled publication or 'approved' indicators surfaced to downstream systems should be retracted.

transitions.cause: Document pulled back to approved state, bypassing explicit Unpublished step
transitions.handling: An unusual path - public to pre-publication without passing through Unpublished. May indicate a data correction in the upstream CMS. The practical effect is the same as Published -> Unpublished: the document is no longer public.

transitions.cause: Scheduling cancelled; document remains approved and ready to reschedule or publish immediately
transitions.handling: The publish date was cancelled. No publication action has occurred. The document is still cleared for publishing and is waiting for a new publish action.

transitions.cause: Author decides to revise content rather than simply re-publish
transitions.handling: The author wants to make substantive changes, not just re-publish. This is a regression of two ordinal positions (skipping In Review). The document is now back in the edit-submit-review cycle.
